sentences.japanese: １００万人の人々がその戦争で命を落とした。
sentences.english: One million people lost their lives in the war.

sentences.japanese: 私の命が危ないと言ってるわけですか？
sentences.english: Are you saying my life is in danger?

sentences.japanese: 君の命を彼女に委ねていいのか。
sentences.english: Are you sure you want to put your life in her hands?

sentences.japanese: 君に出て行けと命じたのだ。
sentences.english: I ordered you to get out.

sentences.japanese: 空港で時限爆弾が爆発し１３名もの命を奪った。
sentences.english: A time bomb went off in the airport killing thirteen people.
